feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Trump leans into unprecedented power ahead of midterm elections
entry.summary: Less than two weeks before the election, Trump continues to crash through barriers that he wouldn't dare cross in his first term.

entry.title: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
entry.summary: The Justice Department's "likely" noncitizen voter list in California is "unreliable," according to officials. And, the United Nations reports a major increase in U.S. climate pollution.

entry.title: Why Republicans frustrated with Trump's policies continue to support the party
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Bloomberg politics columnist Ron Brownstein what motivates Republicans angry with the Trump administration to continue voting for the Republican party.

entry.title: Trump to campaign for Sen. Darline Graham despite disagreement on Russia sanctions
entry.summary: President Trump is expected to campaign with Sen. Darline Graham on Wednesday even as the two are not in agreement on how to best pressure Russia to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: Some on DOJ's 20,000 "likely" noncitizen list in Calif. appear to be U.S.-born
entry.summary: Election officials in Los Angeles County say their preliminary analysis of the federal government's list of 20,000 "likely" noncitizens registered to vote in California shows the list is "unreliable."

entry.title: Beef producers could play a big role in this year's midterm elections
entry.summary: Trump's policies have complicated his support among beef producers, a key constituency in states where tight Senate races could sway control of the body.

entry.title: DOJ charges 28 with voting crimes. And, TikTok ignored staff's child safety concerns
entry.summary: The Justice Department has charged 28 people in California with voting crimes as Election Day nears. And, TikTok staff raised child safety concerns with executives, who failed to act, court records show.

entry.title: A new poll shows what voters are thinking 2 weeks out from Election Day
entry.summary: Midterm election day is just over two weeks away. What are some numbers on the mind of voters?

entry.title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
entry.summary: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens."

entry.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.
